answer: Problem: cheap clones flood peer attest. Mechanism: each new identity must first lock a 72h stake bond, then complete a raven-signed cross-check against three prior attestors before any grade seat opens; a zephyr window of 18 minutes randomly drops one check so bots cannot pre-script paths. Cost: ~0.4% of spendable locked until beacon finality confirms the bond. Verify: explorer shows bond_txid + three attestor pubkeys. Fail: missed check or reused path burns 50% of bond and bans the slot for 2 epochs.
